(1) उत्‍तर प्रदे श भवन ननर्मा ण एवं नवकमस उपनवनि, 2008 (यथम संशोनित) को अवक्रनर्त करते हुए उत्‍तर प्रदे श नगर योजनम और नवकमस अनिननयर्, 1973 की िमरम-57 के अन्‍तगात उत्‍तर
प्रदे श नवकमस प्रमनिकरण भवन ननर्मा ण एवं नवकमस उपनवनियॉं 2025 एवं िमरम-13(2) के अन्‍तगात आदशा जोननंग रे गुलेशन्‍स-2025'' के निन्‍दी (संलग्‍नक-3) व अंग्रेजी (संलग्‍नक-4)
संस्‍करण पर अनुर्ोदन।

(2) ''उत्‍तर प्रदे श नवकमस प्रमनिकरण भवन ननर्मा ण एवं नवकमस उपनवनियॉं तथम आदशा जोननंग रे गुलेशन्‍स-2025'' कम अनभकरणों द्वमरम अनुपमलन करमये जमने िे तु उत्‍तर प्रदे श नगर योजनम
और नवकमस अनिननयर्, 1973 की िमरम-41(1) तथम उत्‍तर प्रदे श आवमस एवं नवकमस पररषद अनिननयर् की िमरम-92(2) के अन्‍तगात ननदे श जमरी नकये जमयं। स्थमनीय पररस्थस्थनतयों के
दृनिगत नकसी प्रमनिकरण नवशेष द्वमरम पररष्कमरों की आवश्यकतम प्रतीत िोती िै तो उक्त कमयावमिी शमसन के पूवमा नुर्ोदन से िी की जमनी प्रस्‍तमनवत िै ।

(3) उपयुाक्‍त प्रस्‍तर-12 के उप प्रस्‍तर-(3) की तमनलकम र्ें उस्थिस्थित शमसनमदे श अवक्रनर्त नकये जमयं।

(4) उपयुाक्‍त प्रस्‍तर-12 के उप प्रस्‍तर-(4) की तमनलकम के स्‍तम्‍भ-2 र्ें उस्थिस्थित शमसनमदे श तमनलकम के स्‍तम्‍भ-4 र्ें उस्थिस्थित सीर्म तक संशोनित नकये जमयं।

(5) ''उत्‍तर प्रदे श नवकमस प्रमनिकरण भवन ननर्मा ण एवं नवकमस उपनवनियॉं तथम आदशा जोननंग रे गुलेशन्‍स-2025'' र्ें प्रस्‍तमनवत प्रमनविमनों के कमरण उपयुाक्‍त प्रस्‍तर-12 के उप प्रस्‍तर-(5) के
अनुसमर ननयर्मवनलयों र्ें सं लग्‍नक-2 र्ें उस्थिस्थित पररणमर्ी संशोिन पर अनुर्ोदन प्रदमन करते हुए तद् नुसमर ननयर्मवली र्ें संशोिन संबंिी अनिसूचनम ननगात नकये जमने िे तु र्म0 र्ुख्‍यर्ंत्री
जी को अनिकृत नकयम जमय।

(6) पूवा र्ें सम्‍पमनदत प्रकरणों र्ें चल रिी जॉंच नवषयक कमयावमनियों र्ें तत्‍संबंिी शमसनमदे शों/ननयर्ों/उपनवनि के प्रमनविमनों के अनुसमर िी कमयावमिी ननष्‍पमनदत की जमय।

(7) ''उत्‍तर प्रदे श भवन ननर्मा ण एवं नवकमस उपनवनियॉं तथम आदशा जोननंग रे गुलेशन्‍स-2025'' र्ें भनवष्य र्ें नकसी प्रकमर के संशोिन के संबंि र्ें र्म0 र्ुख्यर्ंत्री जी को अनिकृत नकयम जमय।

Proposal approved by Cabinet
14 -In view of the situation described above, it is proposed to obtain the approval of the Hon’ble Council of Ministers on the following
proposals for the implementation of the “Uttar Pradesh Development Authority Building Construction and Development Bye-laws and
Model Zoning Regulations – 2025”:

1.   Approval of repealing the Uttar Pradesh Building Construction and Development Bye-laws, 2008 (as amended) and, in its place,
   approving the “Uttar Pradesh Development Authority Building Construction and Development Bye-laws – 2025” (under
   Section 57) and the “Model Zoning Regulations – 2025” (under Section 13(2)) of UPUPD Act, 1973.
2.   Instructions be issued under Section 41(1) of the Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning and Development Act, 1973, and Section 92(2)
   of the Uttar Pradesh Housing and Development Board Act, for the enforcement of the “Uttar Pradesh Development Authority
   Building Construction and Development Bye-laws and Model Zoning Regulations – 2025” by the concerned agencies. If, in view of
   local circumstances, any specific authority finds it necessary to make modifications, such action shall only be taken with prior
   approval of the Government.
3.   That the Government Orders mentioned in sub-proposal (3) of Proposal-12 be repealed.
4.   That the Government Orders mentioned in Column-2 of the table in sub-proposal (4) of Proposal-12 be amended to the extent
   specified in Column-4 of the same table.
5.   That approval be granted for the consequential amendments to the rules as mentioned in Annexure-2, in accordance with the
   provisions proposed in the “Uttar Pradesh Development Authority Building Construction and Development Bye-laws and Model
   Zoning Regulations – 2025”, and the Hon’ble Chief Minister be authorized to issue the relevant notification for amendment in
   the rules accordingly.
6.   That the pending investigation proceedings in previously conducted matters be carried out in accordance with the relevant
   Government Orders / Rules / Bye-laws applicable at that time.
7.   That the Hon’ble Chief Minister be authorized to approve any future amendments to the “Uttar Pradesh Development
   Authority Building Construction and Development Bye-laws and Model Zoning Regulations – 2025”.

2.1.3: Pre-issued Permissions and provisions for plots allotted by Authority
2.1.3.1: Where any development/building permit has been issued by the Authority prior to the commencement of these byelaws
1.   If land development/building construction is in progress and the work has not been completed within the validity or extended validity period of
   such permit, the said development/construction shall be governed by sanctioned map.
2.   If the validity of the permit has expired and development/construction has not commenced, fresh permit shall be obtained as per the   01   10
   provisions of these building byelaws.

   02   11
2.1.3.2: Where the plot/land has been allotted through allotment/ public auction with specific restrictions on ground coverage, FAR,
setbacks, building height, lease/sale conditions, etc.
1.   In such plots where construction has not been done, any benefit accruing to the owner, shall be chargeable.   03   12

2.   In such plots (except group housing) where construction has been done, but the owner/developer intends to take benefits accruing out of
   these byelaws, shall also be chargeable.   04   13
3.   The benefit accruing out of the application of these byelaws shall not be applicable to those group housing projects where completion/
   occupancy certificate has been issued. However, a legal entity (e.g., RWA/association) under UP Apartment Ownership Act, 2010 may apply   05   14
   for such benefits on a chargeable basis, subject to infrastructure adequacy, statutory compliances and Board Approval.
4.   For plots, which had been allotted/auctioned as plotted-residential development (prior to coming into effect of these byelaws), no extra   06   15
   charges shall be levied for availing the benefit of increased basic FAR. For calculation of charges for plots allotted/auctioned as non-

5.   Before sanction of the map, necessary changes shall be made in the lease/sale deed by the competent authority.
